title: Normalized DNC arrow under the actual affine integration transposes
statement: In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], let Y be separated finite type over k and let ell^(r+1) annihilate A. For X=affine d-space over Y and W=X×_Y X, let s be the diagonal. For every normalized Rees comparison and every J,Q isomorphism whose hom maps equal the presented transposes on W→X and its normal cone→X from [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions], let T be diagonal restriction of J with the canonical Tate/source comparisons. Let beta be zero restriction of Q inverse with the canonical normal/Tate comparisons. The chosen normalized arrow delta of [thm-pur-dnc-invariance] satisfies delta followed by beta = T inverse. This assertion does not involve I on X→Y or the dualizing base-change comparison alpha.

source.place: Agreement on the model: integration transpose, diagonal restriction and normalized standard-pair DNC

proof.text: Use the geometric DNC coordinate identity: delta followed by the normal comparison and geometric normal coordinates is the source comparison and geometric source coordinates. Independently the two restricted integration transposes agree in these geometric coordinates. Map that ordinary equation by nu*, cancel the geometric coordinate isomorphism, and then cancel the normal restricted transpose. Associativity and the inverse identities give delta followed by beta equal to T inverse.

mathlib_searches.results: AffineSpace, AffineSpace.over, homOfVector, isoOfIsAffine_inv_over and polynomial coordinate maps; no statement of the required derived map equalities.
